name: BMGREEN
recent: 公司近期持续进行股份回购，并有多项董事及大股东持股变动的申报。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比上升28.4%，但净利同比下降14.2%，净利率从10.2%降至6.8%。新闻关注生物能源与数据中心（DC）业务作为增长催化剂。
notable: 公司于2026年10月至11月期间多次进行股份回购。
非独立非执行主席 Dr Chia Song Kun 于2026年10月5日至7日期间在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司发布2026年6月30日止季度业绩，营收同比增长28.4%，净利同比下降14.2%。
risks: 最新季度净利率从10.2%下降至6.8%，净利同比下降14.2%。
公司进行股份回购，可能影响股本结构及每股收益。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为1.63964亿令吉，环比下降14.6%，同比上升28.4%；净利为1110.4万令吉，环比下降43.3%，同比下降14.2%；净利率为6.8%，低于上一季度的10.2%。

recent_en: The company has been conducting share buybacks and there were several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 28.4% year-on-year but net profit fell 14.2% year-on-year, with net margin declining from 10.2% to 6.8%. News highlights bioenergy and data centre (DC) businesses as growth catalysts.
notable_en: The company conducted multiple share buybacks during October to November 2026.
Non-Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dr Chia Song Kun acquired shares in the open market between 5 and 7 October 2026.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 28.4% year-on-year and net profit down 14.2% year-on-year.
risks_en: The latest quarterly net margin declined from 10.2% to 6.8%, with net profit down 14.2% year-on-year.
The company has been conducting share buybacks, which may affect its share capital structure and earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR163.964 million, down 14.6% quarter-on-quarter but up 28.4% year-on-year; net profit was MYR11.104 million, down 43.3% quarter-on-quarter and down 14.2% year-on-year; net margin was 6.8%, lower than 10.2% in the previous quarter.
